quote_zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将2.4g金属钠(99％，0.105mol)加入其中，待金属钠溶解完全后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应
arithmetic_check: Charges. Sodium metal 2.4 g at 99 percent stated as 0.105 mol: 0.105 x 22.99 = 2.414 g of sodium, which at the printed 99 percent strength needs 2.44 g of charge against the 2.4 g printed, and read the other way 2.4 g x 0.99 / 22.99 = 0.1033 mol against 0.105 mol printed. The gap is 1.6 percent and is within the rounding of a mass printed to one decimal, so no molar_mass_inconsistent is raised. Methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate 34.8 g at 98 percent stated as 0.1 mol: C10H10BrClO4S = 341.60, so 0.1 mol is 34.16 g pure and 34.86 g at 98 percent against 34.8 g printed, correct to 0.2 percent. Product closure. No mass and no yield are printed for the sodium salt, which is never isolated, so there is nothing to close: the only figure is the in-process normalised content of 98.3 percent, and the 0.1 mol carried into step (2) is the same molar amount as the ester charged here. Both printed pairs close against the compounds named, so neither mass_balance_implausible nor molar_mass_inconsistent is raised on this step, and no number has been adjusted.

The drawing corroborates the step boundary and the connectivity, and it agrees with the prose on the alkali metal, so no drawing_text_conflict. It disagrees only by omission: the tert-butanol is on no arrow, although the prose makes it the alkoxide precursor that cleaves the ester, and that omission is recorded as reagent_written_not_drawn on this record. The drawn product keeps the benzylic bromide, which confirms that only the methyl ester is cleaved.

quote_zh: 向反应釜中加入130mL  THF、10.8g  2-四氢呋喃甲醇(99％，0.105mol)和11.8g叔丁醇钠(98％，0.12mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在10℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.3％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应4h。
arithmetic_check: Charges. Tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol 10.8 g at 99 percent stated as 0.105 mol: C5H10O2 = 102.13, so 0.105 mol is 10.72 g pure and 10.83 g at 99 percent against 10.8 g printed, correct. Sodium tert-butoxide 11.8 g at 98 percent stated as 0.12 mol: C4H9ONa = 96.10, so 0.12 mol is 11.53 g pure and 11.77 g at 98 percent against 11.8 g printed, correct. The benzoate salt is charged as 0.1 mol at 98.3 percent with no mass printed, so no molecular weight can be tested on it. Product closure. Limiting input 0.1 mol; product C14H17ClO6S = 348.80; 33.0 g of solid assaying 96.6 percent is 31.88 g of the target compound, which is 0.0914 mol, that is 91.4 percent on 0.1 mol. That is exactly the printed 91.4 percent, and the printed yield is explicitly a two-step figure on the methyl ester of step (1), which was itself charged at 0.1 mol, so the basis is consistent. Mass, content and yield all close against the compound named and drawn, so no mass_balance_implausible and no molar_mass_inconsistent. Continuity: step (1) delivered 0.1 mol of the salt and this step charges 0.1 mol of it, so no scale_discontinuity. Nothing in this section required a flag on arithmetic.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"reactions": [...]}] at line 475, a one-arrow scheme: reactant CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O-])c(Cl)c1CBr.[Na+], C9H7BrClNaO4S, the sodium salt of step (1); conditions texts THFA, C4H9ONa and HCl, which are the tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol, the sodium tert-butoxide and the acidifying hydrochloric acid of the prose; product CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC1CCCO1, C14H17ClO6S, the free acid. The drawing agrees with the prose on the substrate, the alcohol, the base, the alkali metal and the product, so no drawing_text_conflict and no reagent_drawn_not_written; the HCl drawn under the arrow is the workup acidification the prose describes and is recorded in workup rather than as a reagent. The THF medium and the workup water are on no arrow, but they take no part in the transformation, so no reagent_written_not_drawn. The drawn product carries no stereo bond, so the (RS) in the name comes from the prose alone.
